crossRefs.note: Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac,
but Abraham gave gifts to the sons of Abraham’s concubines. While he still lived, he sent them away from Isaac his son…
He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver…
All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.
David took more wives at Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.
Rehoboam took a wife for himself, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of David and of Abihail the daughter of…
But Abijah grew mighty, and took for himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons, and sixteen…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hebron
people.line: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: David took more concubines and wives for himself out of Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron; and more sons and daughters were born to David.
translations.bsb: After he had arrived from Hebron, David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem, and more sons and daughters were born to him.
translations.kjv: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron: and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
translations.asv: And David took him more concubines and wives out of Jerusalem, after he was come from Hebron; and there were yet sons and daughters born to David.
